pubspec.yaml:
name: notepad_pro
description: "A new Flutter project."
publish_to: 'none'
version: 1.0.0+1

environment:
  sdk: '>=3.2.3 <4.0.0'

dependencies:
  flutter:
    sdk: flutter
  http: ^1.2.0 # Added explicitly
  flutter_colorpicker: ^1.1.0 # Added for custom color selection
  
  # Authentication & Cloud
  google_sign_in: ^6.2.1
  googleapis: ^13.2.0
  googleapis_auth: ^1.6.0
  
  # Core
  cupertino_icons: ^1.0.6
  
  # Hive for Offline Storage
  hive: ^2.2.3
  hive_flutter: ^1.1.0
  path_provider: ^2.1.2 # Added explicitly
  
  # Network Connectivity
  connectivity_plus: ^7.0.0 # Keeping updated version
  
  # State Management
  flutter_bloc: ^9.1.1
  bloc: ^9.2.0
  

  
  # Navigation
  go_router: ^17.1.0
  
  # Models & Equality
  equatable: ^2.0.5
  intl: ^0.20.2 # Minor version upgrade

  
  # Dependency Injection
  get_it: ^9.2.0 # Major version upgrade
  # Collection utilities for null-safe iteration
  collection: ^1.18.0
  
  # Unique ID Generation
  uuid: ^4.3.3
  url_launcher: ^6.2.5

  # Mime types
  mime: ^1.0.5
  pdf: ^3.10.10
  printing: ^5.13.2
  archive: ^3.6.1
  share_plus: 7.2.1

dev_dependencies:
  flutter_test:
    sdk: flutter
  flutter_lints: ^6.0.0 # Major version upgrade
  path_provider_platform_interface: ^2.0.6 # Add back for testing Hive init
  
  # Hive Code Generation
  hive_generator: ^2.0.1
  build_runner: ^2.4.13 # Reverted for compatibility with hive_generator
  flutter_launcher_icons: ^0.13.1
  flutter_native_splash: ^2.4.0

flutter_native_splash:
  color: "#1E1635"
  image: "assets/icon_foreground.png"
  android_12:
    image: "assets/icon_foreground.png"
    icon_background_color: "#1E1635"
    color: "#1E1635"

flutter_launcher_icons:
  android: true
  ios: true
  image_path: "assets/icon_foreground.png" # For older devices
  adaptive_icon_background: "#6C5CE7" # The new purple color
  adaptive_icon_foreground: "assets/icon_foreground.png" # Just the white symbol

flutter:
  uses-material-design: true
  assets:
    - assets/
    - assets/icons/
    - assets/fonts/

  fonts:
    - family: NotoNastaliqUrdu
      fonts:
        - asset: assets/fonts/NotoNastaliqUrdu-Regular.ttf
